description: This test file contains unit tests for the functions 'shouldShowPairingHint' and 'resolveAuthHintKind', checking various conditions and error handling related to device connection and authentication hints within the application.

methods.name: shouldShowPairingHint
methods.description: Determines whether a pairing hint should be shown based on connection state and error message.

methods.name: resolveAuthHintKind
methods.description: Resolves the kind of authentication hint required based on connection status and error details.

calls: expect(resolveAuthHintKind({ connected: false, lastError: "disconnected (4008): connect failed", lastErrorCode: ConnectErrorDetailCodes.AUTH_TOKEN_MISMATCH, hasToken: true, hasPassword: false })).toBe("failed")

expect(resolveAuthHintKind({ connected: false, lastError: "disconnected (4008): connect failed", lastErrorCode: ConnectErrorDetailCodes.CONTROL_UI_DEVICE_IDENTITY_REQUIRED, hasToken: true, hasPassword: false })).toBeNull()
expect(resolveAuthHintKind({ connected: false, lastError: "disconnected (4008): unauthorized", lastErrorCode: null, hasToken: true, hasPassword: false })).toBe("failed")
